The '''Joben T-85 speeder bike''' was a [[speeder bike]] model manufactured by the [[Zebulon Dak Speeder Corporation]],<ref name="The Visual Guide" /> and named after the famous [[swoop]] [[racer]] [[Thall Joben]].<ref name="EOFSAOV">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]''</ref>

==Description==
Named for the famous swoop racer Thrall Joben,<ref name="EOFSAOV" /> this speeder bike was initially manufactured by the Zebulon Dak Speeder Corporation. The Joben T-85 speeder bike featured raised handlebars, and a single headlight, Kanan's Joben T-85 speeder bike was distinctive and unique.<ref name="Kanan's Speeder Bike">{{Databank|kanans-speeder-bike|Kanan's Speeder Bike}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Trash-the-Speeder-Bike.png|thumb|right|250px|Ahsoka Tano's speeder bike]]
During the [[Clone Wars]], former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] bought a T-85 speeder bike after leaving the [[Jedi Order]], which was later dubbed "[[Ahsoka Tano's speeder bike|Trash]]" by [[Trace Martez]] due to the fact the bike keeps breaking down.<ref name="Gone with a Trace">{{TCW|Gone with a Trace}}</ref> When she was recruited by [[Bo-Katan Kryze]], she left her bike with the sisters "just in case."<ref name="“Together”">{{TCW|Together Again}}</ref>

[[File:Kanan_Speeder_Bike_Fathead.png|thumb|left|250px|Kanan's Joben T-85 speeder bike]]
The [[Spectres|rebel]] Jedi [[Kanan Jarrus]] used a [[Kanan's Joben T-85 speeder bike|Joben T-85 speeder bike]].<ref name="Kanan's Speeder Bike" /> Kanan and Ezra used Kanan’s speeder bike to get to the Bendu’s dwelling place. Due to being blind, Ezra drove while Kanan sat in the back.<ref name="“Holocrons”">{{Rebels|The Holocrons of Fate}}</ref> Jarrus rode another T-85 bike when he and the other Spectres prepared for the attack on Lothal. Unlike his green one, this one was painted black. When the attack failed, Kanan attempted to use his new T-85 to save [[Hera Syndulla]] but the [[White Loth-wolf]] stopped him and he ended up finding [[Mart Mattin]].<ref name="Rebel Assault">{{Rebels|Rebel Assault}}</ref> [[Garazeb Orrelios]] used his T-85 bike to help launch the [[Loth-bat glider]]s.<ref name="JediNight">{{Rebels|Jedi Night}}</ref>

The [[Trandoshan]] bouncer [[Vrell]] bought a brand new Joben T-85 speeder<ref name="Outlaws">''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''</ref> in [[3 ABY]] which he proceeded to modify.<ref name="OutlawsDate">{{OutlawsDate}}</ref>

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Joben T-85 speeder bike first appeared in the [[Idiot's Array (episode)|eleventh episode]] of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. The name of the Joben T-85 speeder bike, its components and manufacturer, identified in the [[2014]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide]]'' by [[Adam Bray]], are references to [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] characters from the [[1985]] animated television series ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]''. The name Joben itself is of course a reference to [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]], while the manufacturer [[Zebulon Dak Speeder Corporation]] is a reference to the Legends company of the [[Zebulon Dak Speeder Corporation/Legends|same name]], and by extension character [[Zebulon Dak/Legends|Zebulon Dak]] himself. While the components: [[Dusat aft-firing EMP emitter]] and [[Moll K-19 power generator]], are similarly named after [[Jord Dusat]] and [[Kea Moll]], respectively.
